title: Edit Decisions
description: Editorial decisions produced by the Edit Agent.

source.description: Source file path or asset-manifest ID

animation.description: Motion applied to still images (e.g. ken-burns-slow-zoom, pan-left, static)

transition_in.description: Transition type entering this cut (e.g. fade, dissolve, cut, wipe)

backgroundColor.description: Backing color used behind this cut by composition runtimes

type.description: Remotion render template for this cut (e.g. text_card, stat_card, visual_model). visual_model renders a persistent model from visual_timeline.

runtime.description: Scene runtime override (v1: one main runtime per scene). Omit to inherit render_runtime. 'hyperframes' renders hyperframes.workspace to a clip placed as this cut; 'footage' marks a real video/still source.

scene_id.description: scene_plan scene this cut shows; used to hand the scene's visual_timeline events to a HyperFrames scene.

hyperframes.description: HyperFrames scene (runtime='hyperframes'): an authored workspace whose root data-duration equals out_seconds - in_seconds and which loads the generated om-direction.js.

visual_model.description: Required when type='visual_model'. The model keeps its state across cuts because state is computed from the absolute video time, so consecutive cuts on the same model_id read as one evolving graphic.

caption.description: Short heading shown above the model for this cut.

audio.description: Audio configuration for narration, music, and SFX.

style.description: Remotion caption renderer. "karaoke" = PhraseCaptions (remotion-composer/src/components/PhraseCaptions.tsx): whole phrase on screen, each word turns active at its real start time and stays active, the cue and its box persist through word gaps and are held until the next cue (max hold_seconds). Word timings come from props.captions or subtitles.source (a qwen3_tts timestamps JSON). Any other value (e.g. "word-by-word") renders CaptionOverlay: pages of words with the current word highlighted.

source.description: Path to subtitle file or asset ID

color.description: Primary text color (hex or ASS format)

dim_color.description: karaoke: color of words not yet spoken (color = spoken words)

max_chars_per_cue.description: karaoke: max visible characters per phrase cue (default 26)

hold_seconds.description: karaoke: max time a cue stays after its last word when the next cue starts later (default 0.6)

music.description: Legacy top-level music config. Prefer audio.music for new pipelines.

transitions.description: Global transition list. Per-cut transitions in cuts[].transition_in/out are preferred.

approved_runtimes.description: Every composition runtime the user approved at proposal. render_runtime is the master assembly; a cut may use another approved runtime (cut.runtime). Defaults to [render_runtime].

renderer_family.description: Locked at proposal stage — creative grammar for this deliverable. Preserved from proposal_packet; edit MUST NOT change without a logged decision.

render_runtime.description: Locked at proposal stage — technical runtime that realizes renderer_family. Edit MUST carry this forward unchanged unless a logged render_runtime_selection decision overrides it.

composition_mode.description: Locked at proposal — HOW the composition is built. Edit MUST carry forward unchanged. 'atelier' routes video_compose to _render_via_atelier (no cut-schema, no stock registry); requires `bespoke` block below.

bespoke.description: Required when composition_mode='atelier'. Contract for the hand-authored, project-local Remotion render. See tools/video/video_compose.py → _render_via_atelier docstring.

entry.description: Path to the project-local Remotion entry .tsx (typically projects/<slug>/index.tsx). If outside remotion-composer/, auto-staged via directory junction/symlink at render time.

composition_id.description: id registered in that entry's Root

art_direction.description: Short commitment to a fresh visual language (or a path to art-direction.md). REQUIRED — enforced by _run_atelier_checks.

props_path.description: Absolute path to a props JSON (Remotion --props)

public_dir.description: Per-project public dir (avoids copying the bloated shared remotion-composer/public/)

visual_timeline.description: visual_timeline artifact (object) or a path to its JSON. video_compose passes it to the renderer as visualTimeline; every visual_model cut must reference one of its models.
